sloka: ततः शुभ मतिः प्राज्ञो भ्रातुः प्रियहितेरतः ।लक्ष्मणः प्रतिसंरब्धो जगाम भवनम् कपेः ॥४-३१-१०॥
transliteration: tataḥ śubha matiḥ prājño bhrātuḥ priyahiterataḥ ।lakṣmaṇaḥ pratisaṁrabdho jagāma bhavanam kapeḥ ॥4-31-10॥

translations.english: The noblehearted, benevolent and wise Lakshmana, eager to please Rama, picked up his bow looking like a mountain peak, comparable to the bow of Indra and agitated with the anger of the god of Death entered the mansion of Sugriva which stood like the mountain peak of Mandara.
